gloss: the marked passage; the underlined part

definitions.gloss: the marked passage; the underlined part (of a text)
definitions.explanation: The stretch of text singled out by a line drawn beside or under it. Standard wording in Japanese exam questions, which refer to a passage as {傍線部|ぼうせんぶ}A or {傍線部|ぼうせんぶ}(1) and then ask about it.

examples.japanese: {傍線部|ぼうせんぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訳|やく}し→訳す：02319_yakusu⟧⟦なさい→なさる：01307_nasaru⟧。
{傍線部|ぼうせんぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意味|いみ}→意味：01155_imi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}して→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please explain the meaning of the underlined part.

examples.japanese: ⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文章|ぶんしょう}→文章：02957_bunshou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んで→読む：00426_yomu⟧、{傍線部|ぼうせんぶ}⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{筆者|ひっしゃ}→筆者：04348_hissha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{考|かんが}え→考え：00855_kangae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{述|の}べ→述べる：02389_noberu⟧⟦なさい→なさる：01307_nasaru⟧。
examples.english: Read the following passage and state the author's view regarding the marked section.

notes:
⟦{傍線|ぼうせん}→傍線：30459_bousen⟧ (a line drawn alongside text) + ⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧ (part). Japanese was traditionally written vertically, so an emphasis line runs down the side of the characters rather than under them — hence {傍|ぼう} 'beside'. In horizontal text the line appears underneath, and English 'underlined part' is the natural translation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {傍線部|ぼうせんぶ}A: marked passage A (labels used in exam questions)
- {傍線部|ぼうせんぶ}⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{答|こた}え→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧⟦なさい→なさる：01307_nasaru⟧: answer the question about the marked passage
- {傍線部|ぼうせんぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧: to draw a line beside a passage

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{下線部|かせんぶ}→下線部：30432_kasenbu⟧: the underlined part — the same idea described as a line underneath; more common in horizontally written material
- {波線部|はせんぶ}: the part marked with a wavy line — used when a question distinguishes two marked passages
